evidence.text: Custodea provides an AI data platform that helps European SMEs centralise business information, maintain control over their data and use it for analytics and AI applications.

Why Custodea Built to show you your organisation, not your dashboards. § 01 One private data lake, all your software. Every invoice, contact and journal entry from the tools you already use is copied into a private data lake of your own - hourly, daily or weekly. No exports, no spreadsheets, no double entry. § 02 Read it with the tools you already know. Power BI, Excel, Looker, Tableau, dbt - they all connect to your data lake using access keys you create and revoke yourself. Your accountant or advisor gets read-only access in two clicks. § 03 Hosted in the EU. Run from the EU. Owned by you. Your data sits in EU data centres - primarily in Falkenstein (Germany), with backup in Helsinki (Finland). It stays within the EU. No US sub-processors, and beyond the reach of the CLOUD Act. Operated by Custodea B.V., a Dutch company. How it works Three steps. Up and running in a day. 1 Connect. Sign into Exact, HubSpot or Personio with one click. We use OAuth where the vendor offers it, and encrypted access keys where they don't. We never request write access. OAuth or read-only API key Scoped per entity Revoke access at any time 2 Sync. Custodea copies your records continuously - hourly, daily or whenever you ask. New rows arrive in your data lake within minutes of being created in the source system. Hourly · daily · weekly Adapts when fields change Built-in audit log 3 Activate. Work with your data in Excel, Power BI, Looker or dbt - or point an AI agent at it. You issue a separate access key per tool from your settings, and revoke it whenever you want. Works with BI tools and dbt A separate key per tool Share with your partners What we connect to The European SME stack, covered. Every connector is read-only by design. We never write back into your source systems. New connectors ship monthly, if yours isn't listed, it's probably on the roadmap. Ask us. We don't believe in stripping security and trust out of cheaper tiers — they're the product. Still deciding Try it before you talk price. Spin up a Growth-tier trial in five minutes. If it's not for you, close the tab — we don't auto-charge. Start free trial → Frequently asked Things people ask before signing. Are these prices final? + Yes — and they are exclusive of VAT. The price on this page is your monthly amount before tax; 21% Dutch VAT is added at checkout. No usage overages, no per-row charges, no surprise migration fees. What happens to my data if I cancel? + Your data lake stays read-only for 30 days while you export anything you want — your usual BI tools still connect. After 30 days the data is deleted from disk and from backups within 90 days. We can sign a custom retention DPA for regulated industries. Can external partners use Custodea without a paid seat? + Yes. The credentials you mint for trusted partners, auditors, or external analysts don't count as seats. We charge for the warehouse and the connectors, not the readers. What's the difference between Growth and Enterprise on uptime? + Growth runs on our shared tenant pool with a 99.9% target. Enterprise gets a contractual 99.95% SLA with credits, plus an option to run on dedicated cluster capacity isolated from other tenants. Do you support custom connectors? + Connector requests on Growth go on the public roadmap and ship monthly; you don't pay extra. On Enterprise we'll build a private connector against your closed-source vendor or internal system within 6 weeks for a fixed engineering retainer. Where are you in the EU exactly? + Primary capacity in Falkenstein, Germany and backup capacity in Helsinki, Finland — both EU data centres. We do not use AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for any tenant data. The cluster is operated end-to-end by Custodea B.V. in Amsterdam. Custodea The European data lake for SMEs.
